page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn6i.24xlarge is an x86_64 bare-metal instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 physical cores with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, providing 96 vCPUs. The system is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

For accelerated workloads, the instance bundles four NVIDIA T4 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 64 GB of VRAM. There is no local storage included with this instance, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 30 Gbps.

The hardware profile offers high resource density for parallel processing tasks, balancing massive CPU core counts with multi-GPU acceleration. This configuration is suitable for workloads such as machine learning inference, distributed data processing, video transcoding, and parallelized compute tasks that benefit from dedicated Intel Xeon processors and multiple GPU accelerators.
